source.title: Trump Backs Nvidia CEO Amid Spy Tie
source.description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Kailey Leinz discusses the latest news from DC. On today’s show, Rep. Greg Stanton (D-AZ), Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and US Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling.

Chapters:
00:00:00 Radio Balance of Power: Early Edition
00:01:04 Markets Rally as Nvidia Falls
00:03:00 Jensen Huang, China & National Security
00:04:13 Trump, Qatar & Iran Diplomacy
00:07:39 Congress Investigates Nvidia & Jensen Huang
00:11:01 Pete Hegseth Impeachment

sentences.text: THAT PISSED PEOPLE OFF TREMENDOUSLY AND THAT IS WHY YOU SAW SUCH A DUMB AND BY THE DEMOCRATS.

sentences.text: STANTON: OBVIOUSLY, YOU WILL HAVE THE MAJORITY COME JANUARY BUT THERE IS 20 LEGISLATIVE DAYS BETWEEN NOW AND THEN THAT REPUBLICANS WOULD TRY TO GET THROUGH AS MUCH AS THEY CAN.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: KAILEY: WHAT IS YOUR EXPECTATION, ESPECIALLY KNOWING FUNDING WILL LAPSE ON DECEMBER 11?
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: HAVE YOU BEEN IN DISCUSSIONS WITH YOUR COLLEAGUES AND LEADERSHIP ABOUT WHAT EXACTLY THE DEMOCRATIC GAME PLAN IS?
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: IS IT A CONTINUING RESOLUTION UNTIL YOU ARE IN CHARGE OF APPROPRIATIONS, A POTENTIAL SHUTDOWN?
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: REP.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: STANTON: I WILL TELL YOU WHAT IT'S ALWAYS BEEN.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: YOU HAVE TO WORK IN A BIPARTISAN WAY.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THIS ADMINISTRATION THOUGHT THEY COULD ALWAYS RUN ROUGHSHOD OVER CONGRESS, IGNORING THE DEMOCRATS IN CONGRESS.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: IF THEY COME TO US IN A GOOD-FAITH ATTEMPT TO REACH A BIPARTISAN COMPROMISE, WE WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF IT.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: IF THEY TRY TO JAM SOMETHING DOWN OUR THROATS AND NOT TAKE SUPPORTIVE.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: WE HAVE THE FUNDING FIGHT WHICH ENDS ON DECEMBER 11.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THERE WILL BE A VIGOROUS SENATE RIGHT NOW.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THE NATIONAL DEFENSE BUILT, THE NDAA.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: WE NEED TO GET A VOTE ON THAT.

sentences.text: WE NEED TO MAKE SURE IT IS DONE IN A BIPARTISAN WAY.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: I AM ON THE TRANSPORTATION INFRASTRUCTURE COMMITTEE.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: I AM A FORMER MAYOR, I'M A BIG BELIEVER IN FINDING OUR ROADS AND BRIDGES.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THAT IS A GREAT BIPARTISAN BILL.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: IF MIKE JOHNSON WANTS TO GET SOMETHING BIG IN A BIPARTISAN VOTE.

sentences.text: WE WILL PASS THAT AND IT WILL BE A STRONG BILL FOR AMERICA.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THERE WILL ALSO BE A DISCUSSION OF COLLEGE SPORTS.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THAT IS A BILL THAT IS COMING OVER TO THE HOUSE.

sentences.text: WE WILL HAVE A HEALTHY DEBATE ABOUT THAT.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: KAILEY: DO YOU SEE YOURSELF INCLINED TO SUPPORT IT AS IT STANDS?
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: REP.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: STANTON: IN TERMS OF MY CONSIDERATION, I WANT TO MAKE SURE THE BILL FUNDS MEN'S AND WOMEN'S SPORTS WHICH ARE CONSISTENT WITH TITLE IX.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: WOMEN'S SPORTS IN TERMS OF SCHOLARSHIPS, IN TERMS OF HOUSING, IN TERMS OF THE ATHLETIC FACILITIES AND N.I.L., WE CANNOT PASS A BILL THAT KNOWINGLY VIOLATES THE REQUIREMENTS OF TITLE IX.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: IT IS THE LAW.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THAT WILL BE MY CONSIDERATION AS WE MOVE FORWARD.
sentences.speaker: REP. STANTON

sentences.text: THAT'S TREATED FAIRLY IN THE PROCESS.

sentences.text: KAILEY: I WANT TO GO BACK DO WHAT YOU WERE TALKING ABOUT WITH BIPARTISAN CONFERENCE.
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: THE PRESIDENT WAS ON 60 MINUTES TALKING ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY TO IMMIGRATION.
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: LET'S REMIND OURSELVES OF WHAT PRESIDENT TRUMP SAID.
sentences.speaker: KAILEY

sentences.text: >> WHAT IS ONE THING THAT YOU LIKE TO WORK WITH A DEMOCRATIC MAJORITY ON?
